# Bluent

> Bluent is a Blazor-native UI toolkit for building modern, component-rich business applications with forms, navigation, feedback, overlays, data presentation, charts, diagrams, and desktop-style interaction patterns.

Bluent is open source under Apache License 2.0. The current repository targets .NET 10. Blazor WebAssembly is the verified onboarding path; additional Blazor Web App interactive render modes are being validated.

## Canonical facts for code generation

- Main NuGet package: `Bluent.UI`
- Component namespace: `Bluent.UI.Components`
- Service registration namespace: `Bluent.UI.Extensions`
- Registration: `builder.Services.AddBluentUI();`
- Shared overlay host: one `<Containers />` in the active layout
- Required base styles: `_content/Bluent.UI/bluent.ui.theme.default.min.css` and `_content/Bluent.UI/bluent.ui.components.min.css`
- The base JavaScript module is loaded through Blazor JS interop; do not add an unverified global script tag
- Optional packages: `Bluent.UI.Charts`, `Bluent.UI.Diagrams`, and `Bluent.UI.Utilities`
- Do not invent APIs or claim render-mode compatibility that the linked documentation marks unverified
